verdict.rationale: First-party docs state RustDesk runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and Web, with F-Droid and Flathub distribution. Hands-on reports confirm cross-OS sessions (Windows→Mac, Ubuntu↔Mac, Linux→Windows daily use), though with some cross-OS rough edges and one Android-tablet crash report. Missing for 10: documentation of which platforms can act as host versus viewer (especially iOS), clear minimum supported OS versions (older macOS refused to install), and cross-OS reliability (alt-tab and file copy-paste failing Linux→Windows, Android→PC crash).

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
